title: Iran and Gulf states will meet to secure deal for Strait of Hormuz shipping — FT
summary: Iran and Gulf states are set to hold a meeting aimed at securing buy-in for a temporary deal to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, the Financial Times reported on Friday.

title: Indian Rupee extends decline on fresh escalation in hawkish Fed bets
summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its downward spiral against the US Dollar (USD) for the fourth trading day on Friday, with the USD/INR pair rising to near 95.80 in the opening session.

title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens against US Dollar amid budget pressures
summary: USD/IDR gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 17,660 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (ID) struggles with persistent fiscal concerns. As a net oil importer, Indonesia faces mounting budget pressures from elevated oil prices.
